name: INVEX Controladora, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: INVEX Controladora, S.A.B. de C.V. provides financial products in Mexico and internationally. The company offers financial services, including consumer banking, corporate banking, private banking, and asset and trust services; energy transition, such as supply of electricity, infrastructure services, and financial advisory services; and investment promotion comprising stakes in infrastructure and real estate projects.
